items.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-10-07
items.q: Yeah. I believe it was his name, George Washington. Did he play bass? ... That might have been George Washington.

ctx.x: Seems to me he was probably with Sam Morgan then. I'm trying to remember now. About that time. He and Jim Crow would have been playing with Sam Morgan. Yeah. And uh, did you ever know George Washington?
Yeah. I believe it was his name, George Washington. Did he play bass?
No, he played trombone. Trombone. I knew George Washington.
